forward_accounting_scope: Whole tiny Transformer calls only; table and theory submodule calls excluded

result.invalid_mode: correction_mode must be none, shift or affine
result.uninitialized_age: Value correction requires initialized real cache timestamps
result.mode_changed_mid_request: Changing correction mode during a request requires begin
result.zero_cond_t: Value pilot requires ordinary timestep conditioning
result.non_eight_schedule: Value pilot requires an eight-step fixed schedule
result.tables_missing: prepare_tables must complete before enabling Value correction

result.timestep_conversion: scheduler timestep cast to model dtype, then divided by 1000, matching pipeline input
result.schedule_contract: Reuse only with the same frozen model weights, dtype, device and exact eight model timesteps; caller must verify the scheduler before each request
result.interpretation: Frozen hidden-state, scalar-scale approximation for attention Value only; no claim of exact current context or improved image quality
